welcome.title: Welcome
body: Welcome to this little desktop.
It is not a real OS, but it deliberately looks like a 1990s PC: beveled buttons, a taskbar, draggable icons, and the occasional stuck mood.
Double-click desktop icons to open windows. The taskbar remembers open order — the newest sits further to the right.
If you are just browsing, pick an article on the left. There is no account and no submit button.

desktop.title: Desktop guide
body: Icons can be dragged. Move them to a comfortable grid; positions persist after refresh.
Change wallpapers in Settings: presets or your own uploads, stored locally. Prefer originals for a sharp fullscreen look.
Drag the title bar to move a window, drag edges to resize, use — to minimize, □ to maximize, and ✕ to close.
The taskbar has Start on the left, open windows in the middle, and theme, language, and decorative buttons on the right — the last ones are placeholders for now.

apps.title: Built-in apps
body: Minesweeper and Tetris: classic games for zoning out.
Music: demo tracks plus Audius search; for popular copyrighted songs, import local files.
Settings: display, appearance, taskbar, and desktop options.
Document: the window you are reading. Offline content, no annotations saved.
Log: dated release notes for the desktop and apps — double-click the Log icon to open.
Notepad: create, edit, and delete plain-text notes under .data on this machine. Supports titles, word wrap, and Ctrl/⌘+S.
Paint: canvas doodling with palette, eraser, and shapes; works saved as PNG under .data/drawings.

Demo apps: Referral, Bridge, Claim, Stake, Market, Governance, Foundry, Donation, and Email all open on double-click. They are local simulations only — no wallet, no real email — and progress is stored on this device.

about.title: About
body: Name: Mini Desktop
Vibe: Win95 nostalgia shell + a bit of modern web
Fonts: aiming for that classic dialog sans-serif feel
Notice: wallpapers, music, and copy here are for demo and personal fun. Respect copyright.
Version note: open the Log window for release history; Document stays a read-only booklet.

2026-07-19.title: Theme, structure & Notepad
items: Fixed light/dark theme glitches in Settings panels, Document body, and status bars.
Theme colors now use CSS variables; Tailwind dark: variants follow next-themes class strategy.
Reorganized the repo: desktop apps under features/, helpers under lib/, shell under components/desktop/.
Split Settings and Music into smaller section components for easier maintenance.
Shipped the Log window with dated release notes.
Notepad: plain-text notes stored in .data/notes with list, edit, save, and delete.
Paint: Canvas brush / eraser / line / rect / ellipse; PNGs stored in .data/drawings.

2026-07-18.title: Settings, clock & i18n
items: Settings expanded into Display, Appearance, Taskbar, and Desktop sections.
Added icon size, label visibility, placeholder icons, taskbar clock, and tray decor options.
Taskbar clock opens a read-only calendar (react-day-picker).
Wallpapers support local upload and URL import, with a draft preview before Apply.
Filled out Chinese and English copy for windows, desktop menus, Settings, and Document.

2026-07-16.title: Music & UI kit
items: Music app gained playlist, seek bar, repeat, and shuffle.
Audius open-catalog search; import local files for popular copyrighted tracks.
Extracted Win95-style UI: Button, Input, Select, Panel, Checkbox, and Context Menu.
Taskbar buttons show app icons and keep open order.

2026-07-12.title: Desktop v1
items: Win95-style desktop: draggable icons, stacked windows, and a taskbar.
Built-in Minesweeper and Tetris.
Light / dark theme and Chinese / English switching.
Document app with welcome and usage notes.
